adagietto.scoring: Harp and strings (two violins, viola, cello, bass); the source file is a MuseScore score of the same.
adagietto.note: Performance annotated against a reference performance: data/music/adagietto-performance.json has a 229-point tempo map (the piece plays about 1.46 times as long as the score's own clock) and an independent level per section (harp, violins I and II, viola, cello, bass). Hand-set balance, approved by ear. Generic phrase rules still apply as the base; the annotation overrides timing and levels.

mahler-opening.scoring: Full orchestra: the solo trumpet's call, then the tutti, to the second beat of bar 28 (before the strings' march theme). No source MIDI: our own concert-pitch transcription of every part, printed pp. 3-6 of the Peters score (data/music/mahler-opening-score.txt). Trumpets, horns, trombones and tuba, oboes, clarinets, bassoons and contrabassoon, timpani, cymbals, bass drum, side drum, tam-tam, strings.
mahler-opening.note: The solo to bar 8 keeps its per-note timing and effort targets in data/music/opening-performance.json (corrected pickup rhythm, tied notes, measured pacing, unequal triplet spacing, crescendo), on the dedicated trumpet model; from there the transcription is played as arranged at a minim of about 58, broader from the Pesante (bar 23). Part levels hand-set in the transcription. Grace-note pass skipped.

magnetic.scoring: Piano rag. In the game it is a foxtrot arrangement: the right hand's top line on the clarinet, piano, a light banjo doubling the off-beat middle register, bass for the low notes, and a drum pattern added.
magnetic.note: Tempo set to 116 to the minute; light swing; off-beat accents. Balance kept from the first approved pass.

el-choclo.scoring: Piano score. In the game the right hand's tune is on the accordion; the piano keeps the left hand and chords; notes under pitch 48 go to the bass.
el-choclo.note: Tango accents (strong beats and off-beats). Balance kept (per-instrument gains).

gladiators.scoring: Marching-band arrangement (Eric Russ); the source has the band's full line-up including percussion; the saxophones play as clarinets.

ikariotikos.scoring: Source file: one track of the tune (named "Voice Oohs"). In the game: the tune on the bouzouki (island pluck) with a quiet accordion an octave below.

bethena.note: The only part is the piano: nothing to balance. Waltz accents.
